title: Why King Cobras Hunt the Deadliest Snakes in Asia
alt_titles: Why One King Cobra Killed and Ate Over Two Dozen Pit Vipers
King Cobras Eat Asia's Deadliest Snakes, Even Each Other
How a King Cobra Kills Doug in Every Snake Costume
Why King Cobras Swallow Pythons Three Quarters Their Length
thumbnail_brief: A huge reared olive king cobra with pale chevron bands and a narrow hood, the tail of a black-and-yellow BANDED krait (never the plain night-hut common krait) hanging from its mouth, beside a short queue of snakes with Doug last in a zipped snake tube suit, cap on top, holding deli ticket 9, so the title's 'deadliest snakes' read as a queue Doug has joined; text NEXT IN LINE, never DEADLIEST/KING/COBRA, no blood.
description:
King cobras hunt other snakes, including a krait and a cobra, the same kinds of snake behind many of India's snakebite deaths. Doug works through the king cobra's menu in a series of snake costumes, from harmless rat snakes to venomous pit vipers, a reticulated python and, finally, another king cobra.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe and take a ticket. Doug's number always comes up again.
